answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 19 identities per epoch. Audits are published in kernel, queued in violet, and oasis publishes the wait time. A farm of 212 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2654 identities would post 1122 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
